description: FREE lite storefront readiness grade of an ecommerce storefront URL. Runs the same 20 checks as grade_storefront but returns top-line results only: 0-100 score, A-F grade, check counts, and the titles of the top gaps — no per-check evidence, no detailed recommendations. Use this to triage whether a store needs the full grade_storefront report, or call grade_storefront directly for the complete evidence-backed grade.

url.description: Storefront URL to grade, e.g. https://example-store.com

name: grade_storefront_lite
